title_or_table: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B19013, Median Household Income in the Past 12 Months (in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars)
geography: Every county and county equivalent in the 50 states and DC (3144), Puerto Rico left out; Connecticut by its nine planning regions
unit: 2024 dollars, with 90 percent margins of error
qualification: Five years of survey responses pooled, in 2024 dollars; margins are wide in small counties, so read classes with them. Connecticut’s counties are its planning regions, as in the 2024 boundary files.

geoid.description: county FIPS code, state and county

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, Table B19013, median household income, 2020 to 2024, every county in the 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Survey estimates in 2024 dollars; margins are wide in small counties.
